cards.title: Should I try the '18 summers' parenting trend?
cards.body: Emma Brockes argues against turning summer holidays into orchestrated 'memory-making' exercises. She contends that long, unstructured days are the whole point of school breaks, not a creepy attempt at control.

cards.title: Summer childcare tips from orangutans
cards.body: Helen Pilcher explores how scientists say playtime has real health benefits for children of all ages. She suggests parents look to nature for inspiration during the demanding six-week school holidays.

cards.title: Partner's mother dominates him—how do I help?
cards.body: Annalisa Barbieri advises on navigating family dynamics when a partner's parent is controlling. She suggests setting boundaries respectfully without rejecting the mother entirely.

cards.title: Family games night before major life change
cards.body: Dominik Diamond reflects on hosting a final family gaming session as his household of 20 years is about to change dramatically. The evening with his vegan daughters and sons becomes poignant as an era ends.
